title: Extreme Heat Wave Demand Patterns
content: Inventory changes during extreme heat and drought. When temperatures exceed 35 degrees Celsius or a heat wave is declared, Ice cream demand surges by 80%, Cold Beverages by 100%, Sunscreen by 50%, and Umbrellas by 20%. Action: Ensure chillers are fully stocked and functioning. Place cold beverages near the checkout counter for impulse purchases.

title: Floods and Heavy Cyclones Preparation
content: Preparation for flooding and major cyclones. When rain exceeds 100mm or a cyclone warning is issued, panic buying ensues. Bottled Water demand increases by 200%, Instant Noodles by 150%, Batteries by 300%, and Candles by 400%. Action: Create emergency survival kits. Move low-shelf items higher to prevent water damage from flooding.
